```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(dbplot)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(GGally)
library(skimr)
library(moderndive)
library(readxl)
library(ggpubr)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath("C:/Users/antho/OneDrive - University of Massachusetts/Richardson Lab/Anthony R Files/Data Files"))

```

Importing data

```{r}
library(readr)
data <- read_csv("C:/Users/antho/OneDrive - University of Massachusetts/Richardson Lab/Anthony R Files/Data Files/1.28.25 LIQ HD Testing.csv")

# Turning datetime column into datetime object
data %>%
   mutate(datetime = mdy_hms(datetime)) -> data
```
Pivoting the tibble

```{r}
data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("delta_weight") | starts_with("total_licks"),
               names_to = "names", values_to = "values") %>% 
   mutate(exp_side = ifelse(str_detect(names, "left"), "L", "R")) %>%
   mutate(names = ifelse(str_detect(names, "delta_weight"), substr(names, 1, 12), substr(names, 1, 11))) %>% 
   pivot_wider(names_from = names, values_from = values) -> changed_data


```

Plotting on ggplot

```{r}
correlation1 <- 
   ggplot(changed_data, aes(x = delta_weight, y = total_licks, color = exp_side)) +
   geom_jitter(size = 3, alpha = 0.6, width = 0.1, height = 10) +
   geom_smooth(method = "lm", aes(group = exp_side)) +
   labs(title = "Correlation Between Bottle Weight Difference and Total Licks", 
        x = "Delta Weight (g)", 
        y = "Total Licks",
        color = "Experimental Side") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +  # Modern, clean theme with larger font
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),  # Centered and bold title
        legend.position = "top") + 
  stat_cor(aes(label = paste(..rr.label.., sep = "")), method = "pearson")   # Adds R² value
  

correlation1

ggsave("correlation1.png", correlation1)

```
Making new correlation plot, ignoring negative values

```{r}
changed_data %>%
   filter(delta_weight >= 0) -> no_neg_data

```


Separating Left and Right data

```{r}
no_neg_data %>%
   filter(exp_side == "L") -> no_neg_LEFT

no_neg_data %>%
   filter(exp_side == "R") -> no_neg_RIGHT
```

Making separate plots for left and right

```{r}

   ggplot(no_neg_LEFT, aes(x = delta_weight, y = total_licks, color = exp_side)) +
```
